description: This file defines the VTScheduledReport class, which manages scheduled report generation, email notifications, and trigger timing within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: VTScheduledReport
classes.description: Class for managing scheduled report execution, email delivery, and timing within vtiger CRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing database connection, user, and report ID.

methods.name: getReportScheduleInfo
methods.description: Retrieves and caches scheduling info for the report.

methods.name: getRecipientEmails
methods.description: Gathers email addresses of report recipients based on stored recipient info.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Generates and sends the scheduled report via email with attachments.

methods.name: getNextTriggerTime
methods.description: Calculates the next scheduled trigger time based on the report's schedule.

methods.name: updateNextTriggerTime
methods.description: Updates the database with the next trigger time.

methods.name: generateRecipientOption
methods.description: Creates HTML option elements for recipient selection.

methods.name: getSelectedRecipientsHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML for currently selected recipients.

methods.name: getAvailableUsersHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML select element with all users.

methods.name: getAvailableGroupsHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML select element with all groups.

methods.name: getAvailableRolesHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML select element with all roles.

methods.name: getAvailableRolesAndSubordinatesHTML
methods.description: Returns HTML select element with roles and subordinates.

methods.name: getScheduledReports
methods.description: Fetches all reports scheduled for execution at or before current time.

methods.name: runScheduledReports
methods.description: Executes all due scheduled reports and updates their trigger times.
